OR = { NOT = { HSM_AQR_native_pool_VIN_chevaliers = yes } check_variable = { var = HSM_AQR_native_value_VIN_students_influence value = HSM_AQR_native_value_VIN_chevaliers_influence compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
}
